description: Adds a single geometric tolerance frame (IModelDoc2.InsertGtol) to a model entity a view shows, an edge or a face, selected through its view (attach_to, a ViewEntity), never picked by sheet coordinates: characteristic one of the fourteen (straightness … total_runout), tolerance_mm (mm, more than 0) with the diameter symbol when diameter is true and material_condition none, mmc or lmc, and up to three datums, primary first, each the label of a datum tag already on the drawing (annotation.datum makes them; a form tolerance, straightness, flatness, circularity or cylindricity, takes none). The frame is set with IGtol.SetFrameSymbols (SOLIDWORKS' numbers; CADapter measured the string variant wanting font codes) and SetFrameValues2; at (sheet mm) moves it. Checked: the frame reads back its characteristic, tolerance, diameter symbol, material condition and datums, is attached to that entity, and is at at within 0.01 mm when given; the model is unchanged. Otherwise the frame is deleted again (rolled back). Composite and multi-frame tolerances are out of scope.

document.description: The drawing: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

characteristic.description: straightness, flatness, circularity, cylindricity, profile_of_a_line, profile_of_a_surface, angularity, perpendicularity, parallelism, position, concentricity, symmetry, circular_runout or total_runout.

view.description: The view: a reference (r1.view.…) or its name (Drawing View1).

reference.description: A reference issued in the view's model (model.find, view.entities), alone. One of reference or entity.

component.description: With entity in an assembly view: the component, by reference or name; entity is then a reference issued in the component's own part, or a name there.

entity.description: A name in the view's model (Boss-Extrude1, front, Axis1@pin-1), or with component an entity of that component. One of reference or entity.

attach_to.description: The edge or face the frame is attached to, as a view shows it.

datums.description: Up to three datum labels, primary first, each a datum tag's already on the drawing. None when absent.

diameter.description: True to give the tolerance the diameter symbol (Ø), a cylindrical tolerance zone.

material_condition.description: none, mmc or lmc; none when absent.

x.description: Mm to the right of the sheet's lower-left corner.

y.description: Mm above the sheet's lower-left corner.

at.description: Where the frame goes, sheet mm. Where SOLIDWORKS puts it when absent.
